objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document whose creation, editing, release, distribution, archiving, validity extension, override, reactivation and translation are described.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name composed by default from document type abbreviation, consecutive number per type, and title.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the document, including released, editing, and out of force.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, abbreviations, validity period and archive duration.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned for each document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a validity check is necessary for the document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration defined for each document type.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Document level such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating a new document object.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for editing, revision, release, override or reactivation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status associated with the document version.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties of a document in which metadata, references, applications, areas of validity, authorizations, participants and distribution can be maintained.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific metadata maintained for a document and grouped in categories.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose, such as Master data or Control (release).

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing source format of a document opened in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: PDF representation automatically converted from a saved document and displayed on the web.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference maintained in document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: IT application maintained in document properties and used for linking documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained in document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained in document properties.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or system user involved in document management actions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader assignment, distribution and role assignment.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Registered author who signs creation of the document in the first workflow step and can create documents and change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Additional person with personal change rights who may start the release process but does not sign in the creator workflow step.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Participant who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Participant responsible for document and content who decides whether a document is distributed to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User who can view approved objects and can take note of documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Participant who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing sequence for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation or acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated through e-mail notification.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification used to inform users about workflow tasks, releases, change proposals, validity extension, override, acknowledgement and completion.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate it and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by assigned persons or user group users that they have taken note of a released document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard listing documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language version of a released document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new document object.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and document control information in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in the Control (release) category.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document by attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document by attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark a released attachment for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the three-step document release process after document creation, maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review task positively or reject it.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task positively and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participant rejects during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new document version for revision or triggered changes.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive a document by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the document valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process the request for override with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document and attachments invalid, give the last valid approved version out of force status, delete edited versions and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Workflow step in which the creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated document by creating a new version and restoring maintained metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list and archived attachments.

evts.name: start_translation
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for a document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail upon release from persons and user group users entered in the distribution list.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement in the workflow task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in the distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Assign corresponding documents in the dashboard for users included in a group assigned to distribution.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to make a local addition to an existing document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.
